item.title: Retries amplify API timeouts
item.description: A client retries every timeout immediately, which increases queue pressure during a partial outage. Adding bounded backoff and observing retry volume can keep recovery traffic from overwhelming the service.

item.title: Dependency updates need a repeatable check
item.description: Teams sometimes merge dependency changes without recording which integration checks ran. A small repeatable validation step makes the change easier to inspect and reproduce.

item.title: Queue backlog hides slow consumers
item.description: A growing backlog can come from consumer concurrency, slow downstream calls, or a traffic burst. Tracking age of the oldest item alongside queue size helps distinguish those conditions.
